3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: The mood was merry in the Maroon Palace.

4.speaker: Player
4.text: “Surely that should be no threat to our victory, right?”

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: Since the beginning of the war, we had received nothing but good news. Our army's initial successes were followed by further battlefield victories deeper in Rumburg territory.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: I strolled casually into my office and closed the door.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: Iosef entered my office for our daily war briefing. He had an unusually serious look on his face.

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: The daily stack of newspapers was on my desk along with a letter.

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: The first thing I saw was the headline: "Conqueror Rayne", written in giant letters.

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: "Defense minister Iosef Lancea was the man of the hour as his radical plan, in his own words, 'Maradunen Schlium', caught the enemy off guard. Our troops immediately broke their ranks and started marching towards Thornbourgh..."

24.speaker: Narrator
24.text: 'P.S.: Mom is fine and Deana might have a boyfriend.'

26.speaker: Narrator
26.text: "Dear Father. I hope this letter finds you well."

27.speaker: Narrator
27.text: "I just have one request: When Rumburg surrenders and you meet Queen Beatrice, give her a big fat middle finger from me."

32.speaker: Narrator
32.text: Smiling, I shoved the papers to the side of my desk. I heard a knock on my door.
32.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn11_SnO_Letter"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn11_SnO_Newspaper"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Monica_Divorce"] == true) == false)

33.speaker: Narrator
33.text: "...After a string of triumphant victories, Rumburg's defeat seems to be imminent. We eagerly await the day when we can welcome our soldiers back home. Celebrations of Rumburg's defeat have already begun..."

43.speaker: Narrator
43.text: "Defense minister Iosef Lancea was the man of the hour as his radical pincer attack plan caught the enemy off guard. Our troops immediately broke their ranks and started marching towards Thornbourgh..."

48.speaker: Narrator
48.text: I put down the paper to take a sip from my coffee.

49.speaker: Narrator
49.text: "Experts anticipate that the siege of Thornbourgh will be the last push that will drive Rumburg into a full and unconditional surrender..."

50.speaker: Narrator
50.text: "Is that how you old folks do it? I know I could've just called, but writing feels more appropriate for the occasion."

51.speaker: Narrator
51.text: 'I wanted to congratulate you on our approaching victory over Rumburg. We showed them who they were messing with.'

55.speaker: Narrator
55.text: He gestured towards two generals from ATO. Our alliance had been critical to our successes in the field. We saluted each other.

56.speaker: Iosef Lancea
56.text: “We have a couple of guests here today.”

60.speaker: Narrator
60.text: He gestured towards two generals from CSP. Our alliance had been critical to our successes in the field. We saluted each other.

61.speaker: Iosef Lancea
61.text: “As you know, we are nearing a total victory.”

62.speaker: Iosef Lancea
62.text: “But, there is a problem. A large one.”

66.speaker: Iosef Lancea
66.text: “We received reports yesterday that CSP ramped up their support of Rumburg by delivering a thousand tonnes of military equipment to their northern port.”

67.speaker: Iosef Lancea
67.text: “We received reports yesterday that ATO ramped up their support of Rumburg by delivering a thousand tonnes of military equipment by cargo plane."

68.speaker: Iosef Lancea
68.text: “They have officially declared that they will be joining the war. It is possible that Sordland will be open to an attack from the sea.”

69.speaker: Iosef Lancea
69.text: “They have officially declared that they will be joining the war. It is possible that Sordland will be open to an attack from the south and west.”

70.speaker: Iosef Lancea
70.text: “We may be at the Thornbourgh's doorstep, but the CSP's involvement could lose us this war."

71.speaker: Iosef Lancea
71.text: “We may be at the Thornbourgh's doorstep, but the ATO's involvement could lose us this war."

72.speaker: Player
72.text: “We have come this far. We will not fall back now.”

73.speaker: Player
73.text: “Keep on pressing. I don't care who we are fighting against. Rumburg is finished.”

74.speaker: Iosef Lancea
74.text: “I agree. We need Rumburg to capitulate as quickly as possible.”

75.speaker: Iosef Lancea
75.text: “Have faith in the Sordish Armed Forces and our allies, Mr. President. We will bring you victory.”

77.speaker: Player
77.text: “Maybe we should end this war before things escalate.”

78.speaker: Iosef Lancea
78.text: “I think we are in far too deep for that, Mr. President.”

79.speaker: Iosef Lancea
79.text: “But I'm afraid that we may be past the point where we can finish the war quickly.”

80.speaker: Iosef Lancea
80.text: “The CSP's involvement is not a good sign."

81.speaker: Iosef Lancea
81.text: “If this escalates further and the clashes between the two factions continue, we may end up in a war the likes of which this world has never seen."

85.speaker: Iosef Lancea
85.text: “If this escalates further and the clashes between the two factions continue, we may end up in a war the likes of which this world has never seen."

86.speaker: Iosef Lancea
86.text: “The ATO's involvement is not a good sign."

87.speaker: Iosef Lancea
87.text: “A 'world war', one might call it. The war to end all wars."

88.speaker: Player
88.text: “Sordland will end all wars when we win this one.”

89.speaker: Player
89.text: “I don't even want to entertain the idea. I hope it does not come to that.”

90.speaker: Player
90.text: “You might be right. If the ATO and CSP go up against each other, they won't stop until one side wins."

91.speaker: Iosef Lancea
91.text: “Say what you will, sir... this is an increasing possibility.”

92.speaker: Iosef Lancea
92.text: “My colleagues here agree that this conflict has the potential to reach far beyond Sordland and Rumburg."

93.speaker: Player
93.text: “I am not worried. We are winning. Let's be a bit more cheerful.”

94.speaker: Player
94.text: “If what you said happens, do we have what it takes to come out in the winning side?”

95.speaker: Iosef Lancea
95.text: “Sir. Never before have such large armies clashed against each other.”

96.speaker: Iosef Lancea
96.text: “Frankly, I don't know what would be the outcome. This is unknown territory.”

99.speaker: Narrator
99.text: It was the blue phone, a direct connection to Dwight Walker.

103.speaker: Narrator
103.text: It was the red phone, a a direct connection to Leon Malenyev.

104.speaker: Narrator
104.text: This line was used only for extremely urgent calls and emergencies.

105.speaker: Iosef Lancea
105.text: “Please excuse us, Mr. President. We will continue this soon.”

108.speaker: Narrator
108.text: I heard Dwight Walker's voice from the other end.

112.speaker: Narrator
112.text: I heard Leon Malenyev's voice from the other end.

113.speaker: Dwight Walker
113.text: “Mr. President. Listen to me. There is no time to waste.”

114.speaker: Dwight Walker
114.text: “Five minutes ago, our radar detected a missile launch towards Holsord from the unoccupied territories near Thornbourgh.”

124.speaker: Leon Malenyev
124.text: “Mr. President. Listen to me. There is no time to waste.”

125.speaker: Leon Malenyev
125.text: “Five minutes ago, our radar detected a missile launch towards Holsord from the unoccupied territories near Thornbourgh.”

139.speaker: Narrator
139.text: "Everyone at Camp Strongarm is talking about the war, obviously. And they're talking about me. Not in a good way."
139.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Home_Public"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_Arcasia"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_UnitedContana"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_FrancPulledToHolsord"] == true)

140.speaker: Narrator
140.text: "But there's nothing I can do to change any of that now."

144.speaker: Narrator
144.text: "I can't help but think about all my friends and squadmates on the front lines. I know I'm lucky to be deployed here in Holsord, but part of me wishes I could be there fighting with them."

145.speaker: Narrator
145.text: "Everyone's talking about the war here in Arcasia. I have to say it feels pretty nice being the son of the commander-in-chief of the winning side."

146.speaker: Narrator
146.text: "Everyone's talking about the war here in United Contana. I have to say it feels pretty nice being the son of the commander-in-chief of the winning side."
146.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_Arcasia"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_UnitedContana"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Joined_CSP"] == true) == false)

147.speaker: Narrator
147.text: "Everyone's talking about the war here in Arcasia. I have to say it feels pretty nice being part of the winning coalition."

148.speaker: Narrator
148.text: "Everyone's talking about the war here in United Contana. I have to say it feels pretty nice being part of the winning coalition."
148.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_Arcasia"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_UnitedContana"] == true) and (Variable["BaseGame.Joined_CSP"] == true)

149.speaker: Narrator
149.text: "Everyone's talking about the war here at school. I know I complain about how hard it is being your son sometimes, but I have to say it feels pretty nice right now."
149.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Home_Public"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_Arcasia"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_UnitedContana"] == true) == false)

153.speaker: Narrator
153.text: "That said... I can't help but think about all the guys who're still dying over there. That could be me. Considering how badly I flunked my exams, it probably should be me."

154.speaker: Narrator
154.text: "Still... I wonder if you and the other bigwigs back in Holsord know the real cost of this war. It's not just that I could've died. It's that some of the things I've done make me wish I had."
154.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Home_Public"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_Arcasia"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Personal_University_Abroad_UnitedContana"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_FrancPulledToHolsord"] == true) == false)

155.speaker: Narrator
155.text: "It's hard for me and the other guys to sleep at night. I can only hope the memories will go away with time."

159.speaker: Iosef Lancea
159.text: “And I'm afraid that we may be past the point where we can finish the war quickly.”

160.speaker: Narrator
160.text: I heard the crackling of static. President Walker's words were becoming harder to distinguish.

165.speaker: Narrator
165.text: I heard the crackling of static. Malenyev's words were becoming harder to distinguish.

169.speaker: Narrator
169.text: "Defense minister Iosef Lancea was the man of the hour as his superior strategies broke the morale of the enemy. Our troops were victorious in their assault and tipped the scales in our favor."
169.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_Phase1_Pincer"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_Phase1_AssaultTzarsbourgh"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_Phase2_TakeDome"] == true) == false)

173.speaker: Narrator
173.text: "Defense minister Iosef Lancea was the man of the hour as his superior strategies broke the morale of the enemy at Dome. Following that operation, our troops were victorious in their assaults towards their capital and tipped the scales in our favor."
173.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_Phase1_Pincer"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_Phase1_AssaultTzarsbourgh"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn10_SnO_Phase2_TakeDome"] == true)
